ideas.pitch: An AI-powered prompt refiner and compiler that translates natural language prompts into optimized multi-step agent workflows for local execution, built during the prompting workshop.
ideas.title: PromptCircuit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages the event's focus on prompt engineering and targets the Dev Tools track with practical developer utility.

ideas.pitch: A semantic routing tool that directs sustainability and carbon footprint queries to specialized local models, minimizing unnecessary heavy LLM API calls.
ideas.title: EcoRoute AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines efficient LLM routing with the SDG track by significantly reducing the carbon footprint of AI inference.

ideas.pitch: An automated EdTech pipeline that takes raw lecture transcripts and generates interactive concept graphs and semantic quizzes using optimized local embeddings.
ideas.title: EduSynth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive pain point for educators and students by transforming unstructured content into structured learning tools within the EdTech track.

ideas.pitch: A human-in-the-loop healthcare workflow orchestrator that audits clinical notes and flags compliance or dosage risks before practitioner review.
ideas.title: MediGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous AI governance and safety verification to the Healthcare track, making it stand out among generic diagnostic chatbots.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight hardware telemetry dashboard that uses offline-first edge AI models to detect anomalies in IoT sensor streams without continuous cloud connectivity.
ideas.title: SensorSync Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Hardware track by demonstrating edge computing and real-time anomaly detection suitable for constrained devices.
